notes.title: DW Anniversary Flash Sale!
notes.content:
[b]Happy Birthday to DW![/b]
Hello, friends. It's hard to believe, but DW has turned a year old today. It's downright mind-boggling, honestly. To commemorate the anniversary, the game will be 80% off for a limited time. Consider it a flash sale, though you have about five days to take advantage of it if you have yet to give the game a go. For those who have already played DW: Thank you so much for your support. I'm so incredibly proud of this little game, and I really want to do a sequel at some point in the future. 

If you do end up grabbing and playing the game during this anniversary event, consider leaving a review with your thoughts. Any and all feedback helps a ton. As for me, personally? I've got a few projects being cobbled together right now. I'm not sure what I'll end up focusing on yet, but rest assured, I'm still developing new things when I find time for it. Anyway, happy anniversary to DW, and I hope you all continue to enjoy the RPG to its fullest. 
-Space Dog

notes.title: DW is discounted for the Steam Summer Sale!
notes.content: It's officially summer, which if you ask me is a pretty miserable time of year... but the Steam summer sale always makes up for it 😌 DW is partaking, so if you've yet to check out the game and want to try it for yourself, it's 15% off! Perfect for when you want to hide indoors away from the sun and need something to do. Thanks as always for all the support and kind words. It means so very much to me 🎮

notes.title: DW is now available!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Space Dog here. After a year and a half of development, DW is now available! This project has been a long time coming, and it's one of personal importance to me (outside of the fact that it's my first ever video game). I hope everyone enjoys it. If you run into any troubles or bugs with the game, make sure to let me know, or mention it in the game's community discussions. 
Thank you so much for taking the time to check out my game. Have fun, and let me know what you think of it!
